method: Evidence-based regeneration. The audited capability inventory (72 rows @v2026.9.2 + 32 delta rows @v2026.9.4) is embedded as a baseline; a documented ROW_EVIDENCE table records the rows closed or upgraded by real Qubit modules + behavioural tests. Every IMPLEMENTED row is mechanically re-verified against the code and an on-disk proving test that references the cited backend; a row upgraded from an open baseline must additionally drive a real production dispatcher (run_due/autofire, run_op, hooks.emit, kanban API, discovery, ...). A missing or unlinked proof downgrades to UNVERIFIED — no status is hand-flipped. An open PARTIAL row is only promoted to OPERATOR_ONLY when it needs live creds/hardware AND documents a typed unavailable/refusal code; a PARTIAL row with no typed code is left open, so a missing adapter can never be disguised as an operator credential. Other open gates (GATED/MISSING with needs=creds/hardware/owner) are preserved.

rows.note: RPC v4 protocol version/negotiation and doctor are real, but Qubit deliberately runs no standalone gateway listener (single-event-path policy): serve_refusal is a typed GATEWAY_NO_SERVER refusal, not a second server.

rows.capability: Gateway frame guards (validate, don't fail connection)
rows.note: Behavior test passes (399-suite run).
Real peer records + a transport-injected control-channel handshake (link/stale/missing-peer typed); no live network transport is opened, so a live peer link stays credential/transport gated.

Approval/grant-gated supervised-state transition on the one bridge event path with a durable approval journal, typed refusal, revert recovery, and e-stop; proven through the one integration dispatcher.
Real device-scoped token store: issue (secret shown once, stored hashed), pending-approval, rotate, revoke, and scope-checked verify; unknown/expired/revoked/wrong-scope all typed-refused.

Node pairing/enrollment is real (validated endpoint, human-source + confirmation gate, redacted audit) and remote capability dispatch has a bounded injected boundary; a live paired device is the operator hardware gate.

rows.note: One-time hashed setup code + qubit:// join URL/QR and channel DM pairing, proven through the integration dispatcher (code shown once, stored hashed only).
Real loopback CDP path; running Chromium optional (typed unavailable otherwise).

rows.capability: Browser profiles + dedicated browser lifecycle + close-profile
rows.note: Real Qubit-dedicated profile lifecycle (create/open/close/remove) confined to the state dir with injected launcher/stopper seams; any real/user profile name stays typed-refused with BROWSER_CLOSE_REFUSED.
Bounded base64 screenshot; clip validation; typed BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE without attachment.

rows.capability: Remote CDP via node host / Chrome extension attach
rows.note: Remote CDP attach plan via a paired node host and validated Chrome-extension attach over the loopback bridge; missing node/extension are typed, and the live attach needs a running Chromium/node (operator hardware).
Typed COMPUTER_USE_NO_DRIVER; no AT-SPI actuator.
Framework real; executor fixture-simulated; no real actuator.
Bounded, persisted Control UI pane arrangement (validated panes/layouts, confirmed, e-stop aware). It is a declarative descriptor only: it never drives a window manager or reads the display.
Screen snapshot work journal: a real capture path with an injected grabber appends redacted entries to the logbook; the live screen grabber needs an operator desktop session.
CUA browser-state descriptor with a typed unavailable state when the live actuator/display is absent; never fabricates a browser state.
Real transports for whatsapp-cloud/slack (credential-gated).

Discord/Telegram/Matrix/Feishu/Slack AND Signal/Teams/iMessage send + receive adapter contracts are real over an injected transport (bounded request shape + event normalization); with no injected transport every channel is a typed MSG_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and nothing is sent, so the breadth row is an explicit per-channel live-credential/bridge gate with the code path complete.

Bounded inbound ingress: per-channel normalization plus a receiver/sink-injected loop through the HMAC/freshness/replay kernel. Qubit still opens no socket; the live channel transport stays credential-gated.

rows.capability: Channel account pairing / DM access control
rows.note: Accepted setup codes bind a channel DM account to a scoped grant; channel_binding resolves the binding and refuses an unpaired account (typed PAIRING_NOT_BOUND). The live channel credential remains the gate.
Qubit-side capability; needs CDP + logged-in profiles.
Real HTTP endpoint with signature/stale/replay guards; implemented after the 9.2 audit.

Complete Gmail Pub/Sub path over an injected mailbox transport: watch registration/renewal records id/expiration/historyId, and push envelopes are decoded, token-verified, and replay-checked; the live OIDC mailbox transport stays credential-gated.

The monitor's single in-process tick calls schedules.autofire (bounded, idempotent, lease-backed); a job that missed windows while down fires once and reports the coalesced catch-up count via run_due/scheduler_status.

rows.capability: Delivery of schedule output to channel/webhook
rows.note: Channel delivery real via messaging outbox; webhook outbound typed UNAVAILABLE without adapter.

Core lifecycle events are emitted into the existing hook registry (wildcard match, shell permanently disarmed, tampered hooks reported never executed, e-stop refuses); proven through the production hooks.emit path.
Read-only unified ledger; no writer (adapts OpenClaw ledger as read model).

Standing-order auto-reply, flows, heartbeat, and the QA/yield directives are user-configurable as an 'automation:' task text on the existing schedules store (CLI/dashboard/voice) and run on the ONE schedules.autofire tick via the production run_due/run_directive dispatcher; no second scheduler.

Local, confined git clone/checkout: a workspace is cloned from an existing on-disk git repository only (network/URL/SCP sources are typed-refused PROJECT_CLONE_REMOTE_REFUSED, so no outbound fetch ever runs) into the confined projects.clone_root, optionally checked out to a validated ref, then registered as a normal workspace with backup/rollback/audit.

rows.capability: Board canvas: widgets, layout, roles, snapshots
rows.note: Widgets now include sandboxed html/svg + per-tab + declared grants + role grants.

rows.note: Backend board tabs + sandboxed html/svg widgets + the inert plugin widget kind and the read-only show_widget surface, proven through the production kanban API.

The frozen acceptance test test_kanban8tf::test_execution_subcommands_delegate_without_starting asserts typed KANBAN_DELEGATED and that nothing is started. A real workboard dispatch queue/worker runs would rewrite that frozen test, so the typed delegation is the Qubit-safe equivalent and enabling swarm/daemon remains an explicit owner policy decision (not a code gap).
Local reviewed manifests only.
Pinned-source policy: local index directories are really discovered (no network), while ClawHub/npm/git/archive and URL sources are typed-refused with MARKETPLACE_REMOTE_REFUSED.

Real in-process handler runtime for tool/channel/provider/hook: a manifest entrypoint alone never executes (typed PLUGIN_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE), and invoke is gated estop then fresh confirmation then handler presence.
Agent-owned workshop authoring over the verified-skill store: proposals stay quarantined (no agent self-verify), with digest-signed backups and human-only restore/rollback.

Real session lifecycle over the append-only receipt store (search/show/rename/archive/resume/delete, confirmation and recovery on destructive ops). Live subagent delegation maps to the bounded, redacted, depth-capped yield handoff (OC-D25) and live steering is not exposed because Qubit keeps one agent authority.
Semantic belief memory + hash-chained journal proven by the Packet 8M adapter test (the audit's Packet 5B citation targets the base store, not the semantic layer).

rows.capability: Markdown workspace memory / dreaming / external providers (LanceDB/Wiki/Honcho)
rows.note: Local markdown workspace memory + dreaming are complete and local-only (torn-index recovery, confirmation, e-stop); the external providers (LanceDB/Wiki/Honcho) the audit names stay typed-unavailable by local-only policy, so the provider side remains an explicit credential/owner gate.
Append-only, content-addressed token/cost ledger; the analytics route reads only recorded counts/models/providers/days (no fabricated numbers, no prompts or secrets).

Hardware-free work journal is complete: append-only redacted entries, windowed summaries, and a bounded capture_series loop over an injected grabber (capture() is a typed unavailable without a display actuator). The live screen grabber + vision model remain the operator hardware gate.
Hash-chained, execution-identity-bound receipts; any edit, reorder, or head deletion is detected and verification fails closed. Digests/labels only — never inputs/outputs.

rows.capability: Containerized runtime / fleet multi-tenant cells / cloud workers
rows.note: Qubit-safe equivalent of containerized fleet cells: bounded local admitted process cells (no Docker/K8s), while container/cloud placement is a typed refusal. Enabling container runtimes remains an explicit owner policy decision, not a code gap.

One real read-only device inventory: per-family availability probes (browser loopback CDP, desktop, IDE PATH, vision, pinned runtime) plus node-host-derived supported/remote capabilities. Every leaf is observed or typed UNAVAILABLE; availability is never treated as authorization.

Declared remote capabilities (screen/audio/camera/media playback) have a confirmation-gated injected transport boundary and honest typed availability; a live paired node with real actuators remains the operator hardware gate.

Real per-harness adapter contract, PATH probe, method shaping, and a transport-injected initialize + session/prompt exchange (typed refusal without one); Qubit never spawns a harness, so the shipped harness binary is the operator hardware gate.

Real read-only LSP inventory + explicit lifecycle state over PATH probes. Qubit's safe equivalent spawns no persistent client (typed NO_CLIENTS) and never downloads unpinned server binaries (typed LSP_NO_DOWNLOADS); diagnostics run inside supervised opencode runs.
Confined single-file patch with atomic backup/rollback; no host-write fallback.

SSRF-safe fetch is real; search and x_search both have a bounded request contract over an injected provider transport (x_search is a typed unavailable without one). Live provider credentials/transport remain the gate.

Request shaping + dispatch for image/music/video/speech: the shipped shaper runs for OpenAI images and every kind has a bounded provider-neutral request over an injected transport (typed unavailable without one/without a credential). Live generation stays provider-credential gated.

Bounded multi-attachment understanding (count/type limits typed) with per-item typed failures and an injected analyzer boundary so the batch contract runs without the local model; the vision model itself stays an operator-provided backend.

rows.capability: Realtime transcription / voice call / meeting bot
rows.note: Bounded transcription and meeting-join contracts over an injected ASR/telephony transport (typed VISION_MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE without one, no raw audio stored); the authenticated ASR/meeting provider stays credential-gated.

rows.capability: Dashboard compat routes + operations console with real forms/confirmations
rows.note: Compat routes are registered and dispatched through the one shared broker to real registry operations (same backend dict as CLI/voice) with confirmation/cancel; a fabricated route is a typed 404/NOT_FOUND.

rows.capability: Control-UI multi-session dashboards, board tabs, plugin widgets
rows.note: Board tabs, sandboxed widget kinds, and the inert plugin widget kind (validated closed key set, requires the review-only plugin:read grant, never rendered/executed by the backend).

rows.capability: Control-UI panels: terminal / browser / desktop / side chat
rows.dashboard: qubit-devices ui.panels via gateway RPC; /api/qubit/chat; /api/pty typed PTY_NO_SHELL
rows.note: Real Control-UI panel registry dispatched through the shared gateway RPC (no second listener): side chat is served by /api/qubit/chat, browser and desktop report live device-probe availability, and the terminal panel is honestly typed GATED PTY_NO_SHELL (no shell starts; use `qubit tui` or a supervised opencode run). A validated, persisted, confirmed panel layout is available to the dashboard.

rows.capability: Team Reports plugin (GitHub+Discord activity reports, history, summaries, scheduler, HTTP)
rows.note: Transport-injected GitHub+Discord activity aggregation with validated sources, bounded/redacted rows, and partial-failure accounting; the live GitHub/Discord transports stay credential-gated.

rows.capability: Policy plugin (workspace-conformance doctor, attestation, rules, findings)
rows.note: User-authorable workspace-conformance rules + typed findings + deterministic content-addressed attestation; the doctor is read-only, never follows symlinks out of the tree, and attestation is human-principal-only.

rows.capability: File Transfer plugin (node-host dir list/fetch/stream, resumable)
rows.note: Confined local node directory list/fetch/chunked stream/resume plus receiver-side verify_transfer, which proves a byte-exact assembly against the persisted plan (tamper, short, incomplete, duplicate, unknown, and remote all typed). Non-loopback node transport stays typed FILE_TRANSFER_UNAVAILABLE (no fabricated remote stream).

rows.capability: Active Memory plugin (active recall, session policy, escalation)
rows.note: Disabled by default; policy/threshold/dedupe/resolve + confirmation-gated escalation all tested.

rows.capability: QA Lab / E2E automation stack (operator flow, scenarios, reporting)
rows.note: Qubit-safe bounded QA Lab: persisted named scenarios plus a structured pass/fail report, configurable and runnable on the one scheduler tick (not the full upstream operator-flow stack, which is not shipped).

rows.capability: Cloud workers / worker environments (prepared builds, admission, warm images)
rows.note: Worker admission validates the prepared local image set and dispatches a placement request over an injected provider transport (typed RUNTIME_CLOUD_UNAVAILABLE without one); the live cloud placement stays credential-gated.

rows.capability: Node runtime update / recovery (respawn, native hook relay)
rows.note: Runtime/node update recovery: digest-verified reconcile or re-stage from the pinned local candidate, bounded repair, and append-only update history — never downloads and never invents a healthy state; proven through the integration dispatcher.

rows.capability: Secrets egress proxy (outbound proxy, stream substitution, secret registry)
rows.note: Qubit-safe equivalent of a forwarding proxy: no server is started (typed PROXY_NO_SERVER), and brokered egress gets a deny-by-default destination allowlist plus a reference-only secret registry and stream substitution that fails closed.

rows.capability: New gateway RPC server methods (environments, task history, update report, workspace files, plugin mutations)
rows.note: The new gateway server methods (environments.prepare, task.history/suggestions, update.report, workspace.files, plugin.mutations, migrations) are real and dispatch through the transport-neutral FrameReader; no standalone gateway server (OC-01 remains the server row).

rows.note: Loopback MCP hosted-app host: hashed bearer grants shown once, in-process bound handlers only, unbound tools typed-refused, unauthorized requests 401; binds 127.0.0.1 and opens no outbound network.
Protocol unchanged; frame guard validated.

rows.capability: Discord voice channels, voice-follow, transcripts, rich messages
rows.note: Discord voice channels (op-4 voice state join/leave), voice-follow, bounded voice transcripts, and rich embeds/components messages are real over an injected bot/gateway transport, with confirmation, estop, credential-reference and typed-UNAVAILABLE gates; the live bot token and voice media transport remain credential-gated.

rows.note: Telegram photo/video albums (sendMediaGroup), rich messages (parse_mode/entities), mini-app (WebApp) buttons, plus local HMAC validation of WebApp initData are real over an injected bot transport; the live bot token and mini-app hosting remain credential-gated.

rows.note: Slack chat.postMessage transport is live and also drivable over an injected boundary; Enterprise-Grid/multi-workspace routing is an account/origin configuration over the same adapter, with the live bot token the gate.

rows.capability: iMessage private API, media, rich messages
rows.note: iMessage ships a bounded macOS Messages bridge send/receive adapter (request shape + event normalization) over an injected transport. On this Linux host there is no bridge, so the default call is a typed MSG_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and the message stays queued, never a fabricated send; the macOS bridge is the sole live prerequisite.

Feishu send + receive adapters and dynamic-agent routing (per-agent app-id reference, chat allowlist, agent-scoped send; bounded open-platform request shape and event normalization) are real over an injected open-platform transport, and an absent transport is a typed MSG_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE. The hosted open-platform agent app secret, event subscription and app hosting are the only remaining live-credential gate.

Matrix end-to-end encryption is real over an injected olm/megolm crypto boundary plus access-token transport (m.room.encrypted send; receive-side decrypt_event); plaintext is never a fallback. Multi-account homeserver inventory is read from the account store. The live homeserver credentials and crypto stack remain credential-gated.
Image/music/video generation tools share the complete shaping+dispatch contract; the GPT Image model variant is selected through bounded options, while live provider execution stays credential-gated.

rows.capability: Web fetch HTML tag extraction (structured fetch)
rows.note: HTML tag stripping/visible-text extraction bounded + redacted.

Bounded, redacted PDF + transcript extraction confined to files.py roots with a zero-dependency stdlib PDF text fallback (no extractor install required); confirmation and e-stop required, escape/binary/oversize typed-refused.

rows.note: Bounded persisted contract; replay/expiry/estop gated.

rows.note: Qubit-safe local token-scoped expiring read-only share (no public upload); token shown once, hash persisted.

Bounded, redacted continuation-context handoff with an enforced delegation depth, confirmation-gated create/consume, and pending-handoff surfacing on the one scheduler tick; configurable through the schedules 'automation:' directive.

rows.note: Managed local worktrees: a disposable run gets an isolated 0700 detached git worktree, generated content is bounded/validated (symlink escapes typed), cleanup deregisters it, and the orphan sweep reaps only stale bases. No cloud session repository or remote artifacts are fabricated.

rows.note: Real provider-account records plus a deterministic ordered fallback chain/picker over the loopback runtime; custom-endpoint network probes stay typed gated and require an operator credential/transport.

rows.note: Agent-owned collection contracts + curator status over the verified-skill store; tampered-backup digests and path traversal are typed-refused and never applied.

rows.note: Runtime update rollback/recovery/repair/history is the Qubit-safe equivalent of package/service update rollback; proven through the integration dispatcher.

rows.note: Local-first gateway/runtime discovery plus marketplace discovery over reviewed local index directories; remote fetch remains typed-refused. Proven through the production discovery/runtime-inventory calls.
Local OTLP-shaped traces/spans + model-call metrics with a W3C traceparent context; export is opt-in gated and uses a caller-supplied transport only, so nothing leaves the host by default.
